topic: First year to first internship, month by month (November to June)
save_reason: A dated month-by-month plan from November 2026 to June 2027 (what to build, join and apply to each month), on the cheat sheet and in full in the caption.
send_reason: Send this to a friend who thinks it's too early.

cover.concept: Renaissance oil painting remixed with tech: a young scholar at a candlelit desk marks the first of twelve blank parchment squares pinned on the wall, a laptop glowing among quills and books.
hooks: Summer 2027 starts this November. (fear / closing window)
Your senior started in first year. (envy / comparison)
What do you do in month one? (curiosity)

images.name: cover
images.prompt: Renaissance oil painting style, magazine-ad quality, rich chiaroscuro candlelight, fine craquelure and subtle grain. A young scholar in a simple dark tunic, seen from behind and to the side at a heavy wooden desk, reaches up to mark the first of twelve blank parchment squares pinned in a neat grid on a stone wall; on the desk an open modern laptop glows softly among quills, an inkpot and stacked leather books. The figure and desk sit in the lower 60% of the frame; the top 35% is dark, plain stone wall. Portrait 2:3, natural warm colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.

images.name: s04
images.prompt: Photoreal photograph with the warm candle-like light and rich shadows of a Renaissance painting, magazine-ad quality, subtle grain. Seen from above at an angle: a long wooden table shared by several students, only their hands and forearms visible, three open laptops, sticky notes with doodled arrows, paper cups and a shared box of snacks. The table fills the lower half of the frame against a seamless soft lime-green (#cde58c) backdrop. The top 45% of the frame is empty, plain soft lime-green (#cde58c) backdrop with nothing in it. Portrait 2:3, natural colours. No readable text, no letters, no numbers, no logos, no faces, no watermark.
